integrity: The claim distinguishes the paper’s proved time-average extinction theorem from its stronger numerical interpretation. Exact parameter arithmetic is independently replayable from the bundled verifier.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-gamma formula is proved for the invariant disease-free face; convergence in distribution of every interior trajectory to that law is not claimed.
The point-convergence contradiction assumes the printed Ito model with nonzero susceptible multiplicative noise; it does not apply when the susceptible noise amplitude is zero.
title: Extinction has a nondegenerate susceptible boundary law, not point convergence
